split.method: Freeze before scoring new candidates: hold out all E2E smoke fixtures; hold out ceil(remaining code-positive groups/3) ordered by SHA256(group); assign remaining negative-only groups with SHA256(group)%5==0 to validation. Baseline full-set scores were already observed, so this is diagnostic grouped validation, not a pristine unseen benchmark.

threshold_fitting: Exclude every prototype in the query source group during development. Fit the maximum F1 threshold on development only, tie-breaking precision then higher threshold. Keep that threshold frozen for validation. The baseline corpus had already been observed, so this is grouped diagnostic validation, not a pristine external benchmark.

duplicate_exclusion.policy: Preserve every validation item. Exclude all development paths sharing SHA256 bytes with any validation item from both prototype banks and threshold fitting. During development scoring exclude every prototype sharing the query source group OR identical content bytes. This rule is fixed before recomputing any model scores.
duplicate_exclusion.label_audit: Every identical-content group has consistent existing labels; no label was changed.
